name: OmniReason-Bench.1.4LL
description: OmniReason-Bench.1.4LL is a broad reasoning benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on diverse logical and multi-step reasoning problems. It aggregates multiple problem types to test models' abilities in deduction, induction, and complex chain-of-thought reasoning across topics. The suite targets robustness and generalization of reasoning skills rather than domain-specific knowledge.
reputation: Relatively new; positioned as a comprehensive reasoning benchmark with growing attention from researchers benchmarking LLM reasoning abilities.
